ropeway:dlg-guide-body: A tower is 14 blocks: the pylon footing you already placed, plus 13 more. One crossarm on two legs - it is a doorway, not a tunnel. 1. Two posts of four blocks each, standing on the ground two blocks either side of the footing - logs, debarked logs, planks, raw stone, cobblestone, drystone, polished rock or stone bricks, whichever suits what you build in. 2. A five-wide crossarm across their tops: the pylon head in the middle, directly four above the footing, and two ropeway braces either side of it. That leaves a clear 3 wide, 4 tall archway, and the cabin passes through it along the axis the footing's block info panel names - so face the footing down the line before you build. Right-click the footing to light up every cell that is still wrong: red where the wrong block sits, the wanted block's own colour where nothing does. Riding: sit down and the cabin runs to the end of the line. Press the ropeway stop key (R by default) to get off at a tower in between - each press steps the selection one tower further along, and past the end of the line it comes back the other way.
